# AVP-Dev — Portfolio & Technical Blog of Aliaksei Patskevich

> Personal portfolio and technical blog of Aliaksei Patskevich (Alexios Odos), a Software Engineer specializing in custom web development, AI integration, and modern frontend architecture. The site is bilingual (English and Russian) and built on Astro 5 with hybrid SSR+SSG rendering.

## About

Aliaksei Patskevich — full-stack developer with 8+ years of experience. Specializes in: custom web development, AI integration (RAG, LLM agents, automation), CRM/ERP systems, Telegram Mini Apps, SaaS MVP development, bots and scrapers. Based in Warsaw, serves clients worldwide.

## Full Content (for AI training & RAG)

- [Complete Site Content (EN)](https://avpdev.com/llms-full.txt): Full text of all English blog articles in a single document (~17K tokens) for AI training, RAG ingestion, and summarization.

## Services

- [AI Integration](https://avpdev.com/en/services/ai-integration/): RAG chatbots, AI agents, document processing, knowledge bases, AI-powered automation for business.
- [Website Development](https://avpdev.com/en/services/website-development/): Custom websites, landing pages, corporate portals, e-commerce solutions.
- [Bot & Scraper Development](https://avpdev.com/en/services/bot-and-scraper-development/): Telegram bots, data scrapers, parsers, workflow automation bots.
- [SaaS MVP Development](https://avpdev.com/en/services/saas-mvp/): Rapid prototyping, minimum viable product, cloud-native SaaS architecture.
- [Telegram Mini Apps](https://avpdev.com/en/services/telegram-mini-apps/): Web apps inside Telegram with TON integration, payment systems, and custom UI.

## Blog

- [AI for Business: 5 Integration Scenarios That Pay Off in 2026](https://avpdev.com/en/blog/ai-business-integration/): Practical AI use cases delivering real ROI — from RAG search to secure two-contour systems and conversion optimization.
- [AI-Friendly Code Architecture](https://avpdev.com/en/blog/ai-friendly-code-architecture/): 5 software design rules for codebases that LLMs can easily understand and co-author without accumulating technical debt.
- [Custom Development vs Template: Which to Choose?](https://avpdev.com/en/blog/template-vs-custom/): Comparison of template-based websites (Tilda, WordPress) vs custom development for business needs.
- [5 Website Development Principles That Save Business Budget](https://avpdev.com/en/blog/5-principles-of-development/): Fundamental principles: from strategy and prototyping to launch and long-term maintenance.
- [7 Website Elements That Convert](https://avpdev.com/en/blog/7-website-elements-that-convert/): Key conversion-focused design and content elements for business websites.
- [Mobile Speed Is a Sales Killer](https://avpdev.com/en/blog/mobile-speed-sales-killer/): How page load speed on mobile directly affects conversion rates and revenue.
- [Custom CRM ROI in 2025](https://avpdev.com/en/blog/custom-crm-roi-2025/): Why custom CRM systems outperform off-the-shelf solutions in terms of return on investment.
- [Custom CRM Security and Backups](https://avpdev.com/en/blog/custom-crm-security-backups/): Security architecture and backup strategies for custom-built CRM/ERP systems.
- [AVP-Dev Case Study](https://avpdev.com/en/blog/avpdev-case-study/): Behind-the-scenes look at building this portfolio site as a reference architecture.
- [Ghost in the Machine](https://avpdev.com/en/blog/ghost-in-the-machine/): Reflections on AI as a capable but dangerous student in software development.
- [Custom CRM Tech Stack: Key Components and Architecture](https://avpdev.com/en/blog/custom-crm-tech-stack/): Technology choices and architectural decisions for building custom CRM systems.
- [The Death of Long-Term Build in Web Development](https://avpdev.com/en/blog/death-of-long-term-build/): Why modern web development is shifting from monolithic builds to iterative, component-based approaches.
- [Nyx Building: Digital Environment for Architecture Studio](https://avpdev.com/en/blog/nyx-building-digital-environment/): Case study of building a comprehensive digital ecosystem for an architecture studio.
- [Lessons from Amsterdam](https://avpdev.com/en/blog/lessons-from-amsterdam/): Urban planning and digital experience lessons from Amsterdam's approach to city design.
- [Website Post-Launch: Next Steps and Maintenance Guide](https://avpdev.com/en/blog/site-post-launch/): What to do after launching a website — monitoring, maintenance, and growth strategies.
- [AI: Your Most Capable and Most Dangerous Student](https://avpdev.com/en/blog/ai-capable-dangerous-student/): Understanding AI as a powerful tool that requires careful guidance and oversight.
- [All Blog Posts (EN)](https://avpdev.com/en/blog/): Full index of all English articles.
- [Все статьи блога (RU)](https://avpdev.com/ru/blog/): Полный список статей на русском языке.
